facets.description: TestMode3_Create never asserts the async legacy Create call (no AssertExpectations/AssertCalled), so the test still passes if the legacy write is removed
TestMode3_Delete sets no legacy Delete expectation and never waits for the legacy goroutine, so it is racy and leaves the legacy delete unchecked
TestMode3_Update never waits for or checks the async legacy Update goroutine, so it is racy and leaves the legacy update unchecked
TestMode3_DeleteCollection sets no legacy DeleteCollection expectation and never waits for the legacy goroutine, so it is racy and leaves the legacy write unchecked
